messages:
Taylor M: Morning — quick async standup for the launch content + benchmark post.
What I did: prepped benchmark post draft and uploaded assets to Drive.
Blockers: need signoff on hero image from design.
Today: finish final copy, ping eng for API latency quote. @Aj can you drop numbers? :coffee:

Aj: On it — pulling the latest p95/p99 from the bench dashboard now. Looks sane. Will add a 1-line quote for the post. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Nisha: FYI design asked for an alternate hero that matches the new brand kit. I can approve color but need the final image, @Samir are you able to export the 3 variants? :camera_flash:

Samir: Should be able to by EOD. Quick Q — do we want to include Dedicated latency numbers too? The PRD asked for throughput as well.

Taylor M: Yes include Dedicated p95/p99 and a note on reserved capacity throughput. Keep it short. If you have the numbers paste like: `Hosted p95: 120ms, p99: 480ms; Dedicated p95: 90ms, p99: 210ms; Throughput: 300 req/s`

Aj: Pasted from bench dash: Hosted p95 118ms, p99 462ms; Dedicated p95 89ms, p99 208ms. Throughput (default batch=8): 320 req/s. I'll attach the screenshot to the doc. https://redwood.internal/bench/19123 :eyes:

BenchBot: [automated] Upload complete: bench-snapshot-19123.png

Nisha: Cool. @Taylor M I can approve the hero once Samir uploads. Also, quick legal ping — legal wants a short attribution for benchmark methodology. Could someone write a 2–3 sentence blurb? @Aj maybe?

Aj: I'll draft the methodology blurb: `Benchmarks run on GPU pod g4x2, default seq len 512, batching=8, 95th/99th percentiles over 30k requests.` Will DM legal the draft.

Taylor M: Perfect. One more ask — code review: I left a small comment in the content repo PR #342 about CTA wording. @Samir can you address? If not, I can patch.

Samir: Saw the comment, will push a tiny change in ~30m.

Taylor M: Awesome. If no blockers after that we aim to publish the benchmark post at 2pm PT. :rocket:

Aj: I'll update the doc with numbers and the methodology blurb now.

Nisha: Uploading hero variants now. :white_check_mark:

Taylor M: Thanks team — dropping a final checklist:
- update doc with numbers
- attach bench screenshot
- legal blurb added
- hero approved + export
- CTA change merged
Ping here when done and I'll schedule the publish slot.

Samir: Merged CTA, link: https://github.com/redwood/content/pull/342 :thumbsup:

Aj: Numbers + blurb added.

Nisha: Hero approved and uploaded: drive/launch-assets/hero_variants_v3.png

Taylor M: All set — scheduling 2pm PT. Thanks everyone! :tada:
